map.多方指数 n 过程的体积功: Volume work of a polytropic process with index n
map.输入初末态压力与体积及多方指数 n，求过程功。: Enter the initial/final pressure and volume and the polytropic index n to find the process work.
map.📖 查看「多方指数 n 过程的体积功 使用指南」: View "Volume work of a polytropic process with index n" guide
map.W=(P₂V₂−P₁V₁)/(1−n)（SI 单位）。 n=1 时退化为等温，需: W=(P2 V2-P1 V1)/(1-n) (SI units). At n=1 it degenerates to isothermal and the ln form must be used instead.
map.n=1 时退化为等温，需另用 ln 式。: At n=1 it degenerates to isothermal and the ln form must be used instead.
map.理想气体多变过程（pV^n=C）体积功。: Volume work of an ideal-gas polytropic process (pV^n=C).
map.n=1 等温、n=γ 绝热、n=0 等压的特例。: Special cases: n=1 isothermal, n=gamma adiabatic, n=0 isobaric.
map.n=1 且 p1v1=p2v2 时 W=0（理想等温闭合）。: At n=1 and p1 v1=p2 v2, W=0 (ideal isothermal closure).
map.多变指数，描述热量交换程度；升温压缩 n 介于 1～γ 间。: Polytropic index, describing the degree of heat exchange; during heating compression n lies between 1 and gamma.
map.压缩时气体体积减小，外界对气体做功，W 为负。: During compression the gas volume decreases, work is done on the gas, so W is negative.
